items.summary: Add a 'Distributor Delivery Data' management section in the Admin panel. Admin can create, edit, and delete distributor delivery records. Each record stores: Order ID (linked to an existing order), Truck Number, Driver Name, Driver Contact Number, Distributor (linked user with 'distributor' role), Estimated Delivery Date/Time, and any additional Notes. The backend must persist these records and expose query functions to list all records (admin) and filter by distributor user (distributor role).

Create a Distributor portal/panel (accessible only to users with the 'distributor' role) that displays all distributor delivery records assigned to the logged-in distributor. Each card/row shows: Order ID, linked Store Name, Truck Number, Driver Name, Driver Contact Number, Estimated Delivery Date/Time, and current Order Status. The distributor can mark an order as 'Truck Arrived' once they have received the delivery at their location. The panel must be mobile-responsive.

Fix the 'Add Store' and 'Edit Store' map functionality in StoreManagementPage.tsx. The map preview and coordinate display must correctly render using the browser Geolocation API for 'Use Current Location', and the manual coordinate input fields (Latitude, Longitude) must be editable and kept in sync with the map display. Remove any dependency on external map tile providers that may be blocked or broken; use an OpenStreetMap iframe embed or a plain coordinate display with a Leaflet/static map fallback so the map always renders without errors.
